changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.sql: WITH carried AS ( SELECT 'panel-upgrade-' || substr(md5(pa.antibiotic_id || '|' || pa.report_behavior || '|' || coalesce(o.id, '')), 1, 22) AS id, pa.antibiotic_id, pa.report_behavior, o.id AS organism_id, 'Carried over on upgrade from AST ' || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT p.id) > 1 THEN 'panels ' ELSE 'panel ' END || string_agg(DISTINCT '"' || p.name || '"' || CASE WHEN pa.report_behavior = 'CASCADE' THEN ' (tier ' || pa.tier || ')' ELSE '' END, ', ') || CASE WHEN pa.report_behavior = 'CASCADE' THEN '. Panel tiers are not cascade conditions: set the condition, then review before activating.' ELSE '. Review before activating.' END AS origin FROM clinlims.micro_ast_panel_antibiotic pa JOIN clinlims.micro_ast_panel p ON p.id = pa.panel_id AND p.is_current = 'Y' LEFT JOIN (clinlims.micro_organism o JOIN clinlims.micro_ast_panel d ON d.id = o.default_ast_panel_id) ON d.logical_key = p.logical_key WHERE pa.report_behavior <> 'ALWAYS' GROUP BY pa.antibiotic_id, pa.report_behavior, o.id ), rules AS ( INSERT INTO clinlims.micro_reporting_rule (id, antibiotic_id, organism_id, report_behavior, add_automatically, active, last_updated) SELECT id, antibiotic_id, organism_id, report_behavior, false, false, now() FROM carried ) INSERT INTO clinlims.micro_reporting_rule_history (id, rule_id, revision, changed_at, changed_by, after_value, last_updated) SELECT md5(id)::uuid::text, id, 1, now(), (SELECT id::text FROM clinlims.system_user WHERE login_name = 'daemon'), json_build_object('antibioticId', antibiotic_id, 'organismId', organism_id, 'organismGroup', null, 'sampleTypeIds', json_build_array(), 'clinicalContext', null, 'reportBehavior', report_behavior, 'cascadeCondition', null, 'note', null, 'noteWhen', null, 'addAutomatically', false, 'active', false, 'origin', origin)::text, now() FROM carried

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.micro_reporting_rule_history WHERE rule_id LIKE 'panel-upgrade-%'
DELETE FROM clinlims.micro_reporting_rule_sample_type WHERE rule_id LIKE 'panel-upgrade-%'
DELETE FROM clinlims.micro_reporting_rule WHERE id LIKE 'panel-upgrade-%'

ALTER TABLE clinlims.micro_ast_panel_antibiotic ADD CONSTRAINT micro_ast_panel_antibiotic_report_chk CHECK (report_behavior IN ('ALWAYS', 'CASCADE', 'SUPPRESS_UNLESS_RESISTANT'))
